overview_description.description: Standard Nuclear is a technology company that manufactures advanced nuclear fuel and related power systems for use in next-generation nuclear reactors and other high-temperature applications. It focuses on producing tri-structural isotropic particle fuel, a form of nuclear fuel designed for use in small modular and advanced reactors, and supplies these materials to commercial and government customers. The company’s offerings include reactor-agnostic fuel products and radioisotope power solutions intended to support energy and defense initiatives. It also engages in collaborations and agreements with public agencies to expand fuel production and align with broader energy infrastructure needs. Standard Nuclear’s operations aim to strengthen supply chains for nuclear fuel production and support customers across energy and related technical sectors.
